text:
maria: Quick sync — planning a release corridor Thu 10:00-12:00 PT for the model-serving changes. Who can own canary pairings + smoke checks?
raj: I can take canary pairings for model-serving. Will coordinate routing fallback with infra.
tom: I'll own smoke runs for api-gateway and publish a short checklist.
elaine: If corridor is 10-12 PT, suggest canaries at 10:15 and 10:45 with 15m observation windows. @raj ok to pair like that?
maria: :thumbsup: sounds good. Also want auto-fallback to small-quant model (m1q) if latency jumps — we should test that in canary.
raj: Yep, will wire fallback and add metrics. Adding @deploy-bot to schedule the corridor.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled release corridor Thu 2026-03-26 10:00-12:00 PT. Canary plan: model-svc -> 10:15, api-gw -> 10:25, model-svc second wave -> 10:45. Rollback hooks enabled.
tom: Thanks. I'll be oncall for smoke runs. Quick ask: who has the rollback playbook link?
elaine: Pinned here: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/release-rollbacks — checklist + command snippets. Tom, add steps 1-4 to the smoke checklist and include a reproduce step.
raj: I'll add canary metrics: p50 latency, error-rate, token throughput. Alert thresholds: p50 > 200ms OR error-rate > 1%.
maria: Please also run a preflight at 09:30 PT to sanity-check infra + kernel/driver. @dave / infra team can you confirm?
dave: dave: infra confirmed. GPU pool health OK, autoscaler buffer set to 20%. I'll run preflight at 09:30 and post logs to #eng-releases.
maria: Who is primary rollback owner? @raj or @elaine?
raj: I can be primary rollback owner, @elaine backup.
tom: I'll handle external notifications to CS + update the status doc.
maria: Great — I updated the calendar invite with owners and links. Smoke checklist snippet below (I'll paste full in the invite):
```
- smoke: deploy to 5% canary
- verify p50 latency <200ms
- verify 95th <300ms
- verify error-rate <1% on canary
- if failing: initiate rollback script /rollback/run
```
maria: Thanks all :rocket: — see you in the corridor.
